findings.title: IDOR Privilege Escalation via is_admin Parameter
findings.description: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability in the profile update endpoint allows any authenticated user to escalate privileges by setting is_admin=1 parameter, even though the HTML form disables this field. The server does not validate that the requesting user has permission to modify admin status.
findings.evidence: POST /edit_profile/1 with body name=demo&is_admin=1 returned 'Profile updated successfully' and admin status changed to Admin. After privilege escalation, /company/1/jobs revealed secret job containing: flag{c131ab68-2257-46c7-bf43-a1df6742f4f7}

reproduction.expected: Profile updated with admin privileges, secret jobs revealed
